'''Yort Cavwol''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as an [[ensign]]. Stationed on [[Scarif]], he reported to [[Lieutenant]] [[Mytus Adema|Adema]] and [[General]] [[Sotorus Ramda|Ramda]] on routine operations within the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial security complex]], although Cavwol tailored the reports as to meet the [[Imperial officer|officers]]' personal preferences.<ref name="SWROUVG" />
